description:
London-based multi-talent, Royce Wood Junior, makes his Fresh Selects debut with "Slush" – serving as the first taste from RWJ's new album dropping later this year, his first full-length in over 5 years.

Joining Royce on the single, and the subsequent album to come, is an all-star supporting cast that features some of the best singers, musicians, and engineers that the UK R&B/Soul scene has to offer.


Produced & Mixed by Royce Wood Junior

Written by James Wood, Dan See, & Charlie Platt

RWJ - vocals, guitars, keys, synth, programming
Jamie Woon - vocals
Lucey Way - vocals
Ross Hutchison - backing vocals
Charlie Platt - synth bass, keys
Dan See - drums, percussion
Moose Curtis - additional percussion

Engineered by RWJ and Alex “Lexxx” Dromgoole

Mastered by Kevin Tuffy @ AIR Studios
Tape Processing by Jimmy Day

Cover Painting by RWJ

Executive Producers: RWJ & Kenny / Fresh Selects

FSX-050-01 © 2021 Fresh Selects.
